subject.title: fix(macos): keep polling gateway-executed wizard steps

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR proceed after a refreshed merge result and real macOS after-fix proof, or does the protected label require an owner-specific validation path?
rationale: The code path is focused and the existing web counterpart supports the approach, but the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling and the external proof gate is not satisfied by mocked transport coverage alone.

options.title: Request macOS proof, then review
options.body: Ask for a redacted onboarding recording or CLI transcript against a real Gateway after refreshing the branch, then complete normal code review.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused fake-socket regression test and Swift build as sufficient for this narrow client mirror.
